contentItem.title: 等量关系：棱锥与棱柱
contentItem.englishTitle: If there be two pyramids of the same height which have triangular bases, and each of them be divided into two pyramids equal to one another and similar to the whole, and into two equal prisms, then, as the base of the one pyramid is to the base of the other pyramid, so will all the prisms in the one pyramid be to all the prisms, being equal in multitude, in the other pyramid.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If there be two pyramids of the same height which have triangular bases, and each of them be divided into two pyramids equal to one another and similar to the whole, and into two equal prisms, then, as the base of the one pyramid is to the base of the other pyramid, so will all the prisms in the one pyramid be to all the prisms, being equal in multitude, in the other pyramid.
如果两个高点的金字塔 具有三角底边, 并且每个都分为两个 等同彼此的金字塔, 和整个相似, 和两个等同的棱镜, 那么,当一个金字塔的底边 与另一个金字塔的底边 一样, 一个金字塔的所有棱镜 也都属于另一个金字塔的所有棱镜, 数量相同, 并且是一个金字塔的所有棱镜。

Let there be two pyramids of the same height which have the triangular bases ABC, DEF, and vertices the points G, H, and let each of them be divided into two pyramids equal to one another and similar to the whole and into two equal prisms; [[XII. 3](/principles/euclid-12-3)] I say that, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so are all the prisms in the pyramid ABCG to all the prisms, being equal in multitude, in the pyramid DEFH,
这两座金字塔的高度相同 三角形底边、ABC、DEF 顶端G、H 每一个都分为两个金字塔 等同于彼此 类似整个和两条平等棱镜（相关点与线段：ABCG、DEFH） [[XII. 3](/principles/euclid-12-3)]
For, since BO is equal to OC, and AL to LC, therefore LO is parallel to AB, and the triangle ABC is similar to the triangle LOC.
因为BO等于OC,AL至LC,因此LO等于AB,三角形ABC类似于三角形LOC。
For the same reason the triangle DEF is also similar to the triangle RVF.
出于同样的原因,三角形DEF也与三角形RVF类似。
And, since BC is double of CO, and EF of FV, therefore, as BC is to CO, so is EF to FV.
BC是CO的两倍,FV是EF,因此,BC对CO的比等于EF对FV的比；BC 与 CO 之比等于 EF 与 FV 之比。

And on BC, CO are described the similar and similarly situated rectilineal figures ABC, LOC, and on EF, FV the similar and similarly situated figures DEF, RVF; therefore, as the triangle ABC is to the triangle LOC, so is the triangle DEF to the triangle RVF; [[VI. 22](/principles/euclid-6-22)] therefore, alternately, as the triangle ABC is to the triangle DEF, so is the triangle LOC to the triangle RVF. [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]

BC,CO被描述为类似和类似直线图ABC,LOC,EF,FV被描述为类似和类似;因此,三角ABC和三角LOC的比例等于三角DEF和三角RVF的比例;因此,三角ABC和三角DEF的比例则等于三角LOC和三角RVF的比例；ABC 与 LOC 之比等于 DEF 与 RVF 之比；ABC 与 DEF 之比等于 LOC 与 RVF 之比。 [[VI. 22](/principles/euclid-6-22)] [[V. 16](/principles/euclid-5-16)]

But, as the triangle LOC is to the triangle RVF, so is the prism in which the triangle LOC is the base and PMN its opposite to the prism in which the triangle RVF is the base and STU its opposite; [Lemma following] therefore also, as the triangle ABC is to the triangle DEF, so is the prism in which the triangle LOC is the base and PMN its opposite to the prism in which the triangle RVF is the base and STU its opposite.
但是,三角LOC对三角RVF的比等于棱镜LOC是底边和PMN,而三角RVF是底边和STU是相反的棱镜;因此,三角ABC对三角DEF的比也等于三角LOC和PMN之间的棱镜比,三角LOC是底边和PMN,而三角RVF是底边和STU是相反的棱镜

But, as the said prisms are to one another, so is the prism in which the parallelogram KBOL is the base and the straight line PM its opposite to the prism in which the parallelogram QEVR is the base and the straight line ST its opposite. [[XI. 39](/principles/euclid-11-39); cf. [XII. 3](/principles/euclid-12-3)]
但是,正如上述棱镜相互之间所言,平行四边形 KBOL线是底边,PM线是直线,而平行四边形 QEVR线是底边,ST线是相反的棱镜。 [ [XI. 39](/principles/euclid-11-39) [XII. 3](/principles/euclid-12-3)

Therefore also the two prisms, that in which the parallelogram KBOL is the base and PM its opposite, and that in which the triangle LOC is the base and PMN its opposite, are to the prisms in which QEVR is the base and the straight line ST its opposite and in which the triangle RVF is the base and STU its opposite in the same ratio [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)]
因此,两个棱镜,即平行四边形 KBOL是底边和PM是相反的,而三角LOC是底边和PMN是相反的,也是QEVR是底边和ST直线是相反的,三角RVF是底边和STU是相同比例的相反。 [[V. 12](/principles/euclid-5-12)]
Therefore also, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so are the said two prisms to the said two prisms.
因此,底边 ABC也属于底边 DEF,而上述两条棱镜的两条棱镜也是如此

And similarly, if the pyramids PMNG, STUH be divided into two prisms and two pyramids, as the base PMN is to the base STU, so will the two prisms in the pyramid PMNG be to the two prisms in the pyramid STUH.
同样,如果金字塔PMNG,STUH 被分为两个棱镜和两个金字塔, 底边,PMN 则被分为底边,STU, 金字塔PMNG的两个棱镜 STUH 被分为两个金字塔STUH。
But, as the base PMN is to the base STU, so is the base ABC to the base DEF; for the triangles PMN, STU are equal to the triangles LOC, RVF respectively.
但是,底边 PMN对底边 STU的比等于底边 ABC对底边 DEF的比;三角形PMN,STU分别等于三角形LOC、RVF；PMN 与 STU 之比等于 ABC 与 DEF 之比。
Therefore also, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so are the four prisms to the four prisms.
因此,底边 ABC也属于底边 DEF,四号的四棱镜也是如此

And similarly also, if we divide the remaining pyramids into two pyramids and into two prisms, then, as the base ABC is to the base DEF, so will all the prisms in the pyramid ABCG be to all the prisms, being equal in multitude, in the pyramid DEFH. Q. E. D.
同样,如果我们把剩下的金字塔分成两个金字塔和两个棱镜,那么,底边 ABC是底边 DEF,金字塔ABCG的所有棱镜,在DEFH金字塔中,证毕。

Lemma. But that, as the triangle LOC is to the triangle RVF, so is the prism in which the triangle LOC is the base and PMN its opposite to the prism in which the triangle RVF is the base and STU its opposite, we must prove as follows.
莱姆马。 但是,三角LOC对三角RVF的比例等于棱镜LOC是底边和PMN,而三角RVF是底边和STU是相反的棱镜,我们必须证明如下
For in the same figure let perpendiculars be conceived drawn from G, H to the planes ABC, DEF; these are of course equal because, by hypothesis, the pyramids are of equal height.
在同一数字中,直肠从G、H到平面,ABC、DEF;当然,这些是平等的,因为假设金字塔的高度相等。
Now, since the two straight lines GC and the perpendicular from G are cut by the parallel planes ABC, PMN, they will be cut in the same ratios. [[XI. 17](/principles/euclid-11-17)]
现在,既然GC线和G线的直线 被平面、ABC线截断,PMN线将被按同样比例削减 [[XI. 17](/principles/euclid-11-17)]
And GC is bisected by the plane PMN at N; therefore the perpendicular from G to the plane ABC will also be bisected by the plane PMN.
GC被平面 PMNN双切,G到平面 ABC的垂直线也将被平面 PMN双切线所分。
For the same reason the perpendicular from H to the plane DEF will also be bisected by the plane STU.
出于同样原因,H至平面 DEF之间的垂直点也将被平面 STU相隔开。
And the perpendiculars from G, H to the planes ABC, DEF are equal; therefore the perpendiculars from the triangles PMN, STU to the planes ABC, DEF are also equal.
直肠从G,H到平面,ABC,DEF是相等的。 因此,三角形从PMN,STU到平面,ABC,DEF的直肠也是相等的。
Therefore the prisms in which the triangles LOC, RVF are bases, and PMN, STU their opposites, are of equal height.
因此,三角形LOC,RVF是底边, 和对立方的PMN,STU, 高度相等。

Hence also the parallelepipedal solids described from the said prisms are of equal height and are to one another as their bases; [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)] therefore their halves, namely the said prisms, are to one another as the base LOC is to the base RVF. Q. E. D.
因此,上述棱镜中描述的平行管道固体也具有同等高度,彼此是底边;因此,它们的二分之一,即上述棱镜,是相互的,因为底边 LOC是底边 RVF,QE。 [[XI. 32](/principles/euclid-11-32)]
